property_summary: For the owner, after calling sendMoney(target, amount) with sufficient contract balance, the call must succeed (not revert), which the bug violates when target is a contract that reverts on receive because the original properly propagates the failure revert while the bug silently succeeds.
change_summary: Delete the entire body of sendMoney, making it a no-op that does not transfer any Ether, so the balance of the contract and the recipient remain unchanged after the call.
